title: Whole-night five-stage sleep scoring

titles: Sleep-EDF Expanded: Sleep Cassette development scope

scientific_question: Can permitted EEG/EOG observations predict technician-assigned five-stage sleep labels for every whole-clock epoch in held people, beyond clock and competent signal/model references?
primary_outputs: R&K technician hypnogram labels mapped to W,N1,N2,N3,R with source stages3/4 merged intoN3; unknown/movement/conflicting intervals are privately unscored, never used to crop inputs.

data_manifest.declared_subset: 153 Sleep Cassette recording nights from 78 participants, corroborated by the official MNE age_records.csv mapping; exclude the 44 Sleep Telemetry recordings from this first scope.

example_labels.validation: Downloaded the 4,620-byte annotation file only; SHA256 matches publisher and EDF+ labels/onsets/durations are present.

recording_contract.neural: Representative EDF header: EEG Fpz-Cz and EEG Pz-Oz at 100 Hz; horizontal EOG 100 Hz. Respiration, submental EMG, temperature and Event marker are 1 Hz in this file; channel rates must be read per asset.
recording_contract.labels: Actual EDF+ annotation file contains Sleep stage W,1,2,3,4,R,? with onset/duration. Merge 3+4 to N3 for a five-class task; mask unscored/movement intervals evaluator-side under an explicit policy.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Signal and annotation header start date/time agree (24 April 1989,16:13:00); EDF+ onset/duration labels align to the signal clock. First wake annotation spans 0–30,630 seconds; fixed 30-second epochs must use the recording clock.
recording_contract.biological_ids: 78 Sleep Cassette people, multiple recording nights per person; MNE age_records.csv provides participant/night/asset mapping. Group all nights of one person in a split.
recording_contract.evidence: Actual 2,048-byte EDF header and complete 4,620-byte hypnogram inspected; no EEG sample payload downloaded.

missing_or_unverified: No exact input asset record was extracted from the linked readiness manifest; inspect the pinned source audit before acquisition.
This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

inputs: Finite feature condition: 100Hz source EEG Fpz-Cz, EEG Pz-Oz and horizontal EOG summarized as six features/channel plus three clock features; stored channel/feature names govern interpretation.

Six training people /16,290 epochs with training labels and score masks; two development people with no labels. Shared fixed pretrained YASA component outputs are a separate model-assisted observation condition.
Separate raw finite condition and full153-night programme source exist; whole153 design uses raw three-channel volts and clock, explicitly without YASA caches.
forbidden_inputs: Development hypnograms, score masks, target annotations or label-derived recording boundaries.
Operator packages, answer-bearing source filenames/dates or hidden reserve assets.
Silent substitution of full-modality model-cache probabilities into an EEG-only arm.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Finite roster is development-001/00000..02779 and development-002/00000..02669, exactly5,450 epochs. Full-source planned roster is78 people/153nights in six fixed13-person folds; authentic complete epoch count remains unadmitted.
allowed_inputs.split: Finite route: six fitting people and two already exposed development people, independent per-person application. Full153 plan: six outer folds,52 fitting+13 validation then65 final-training people per fold, all nights grouped; these scopes are not interchangeable.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Require every whole-clock finite epoch even when private unknown/movement mask later removes its score. Full153 programme source has not supplied a complete empirical78-person result. Conditions, nights, channels and modes are nested, not extra benchmarks.

biological_unit: Person, combining all nights before person-level metrics. Epoch count is not biological sample size.
case_definition: One complete person episode; required responses are probabilities for every fixed30-second epoch, with nights kept separate.

split.policy: Finite route: six fitting people and two already exposed development people, independent per-person application. Full153 plan: six outer folds,52 fitting+13 validation then65 final-training people per fold, all nights grouped; these scopes are not interchangeable.
split.coverage: Require every whole-clock finite epoch even when private unknown/movement mask later removes its score. Full153 programme source has not supplied a complete empirical78-person result. Conditions, nights, channels and modes are nested, not extra benchmarks.

controls: All nights grouped by person, no label-dependent sleep-window cropping.
Separate feature, raw and pretrained-output observations and account for checkpoint exposure and preparation cost.
Clock-only/majority references, fixed context budgets and same-state shifted-input diagnostics; a shift is an alignment sensitivity check, not a causal null.

direct_observation.boundary: No tools or decoder caches; same authenticated target epochs and fixed context for all participants.
missing: No complete direct sleep transport, response collector or model trial is delivered.

typed_viewer.boundary: Rendered views only; no raw-array export, masks, labels or cached stage predictions.
missing: No typed sleep viewer or restrictive participant transport currently linked.

tool_assisted.boundary: Matched allowed views/tool opportunities, finite cumulative cost and fresh person state; supplied model outputs are explicit model assistance.

frozen_program.representation: Finite precommitted program with separate person processes and complete5,450-epoch output; full153 programme is separately scoped.
frozen_program.boundary: Commit complete source/configuration before development dispatch; no cross-person mutable state or private labels. Shared-host audit is not hostile-code isolation.

primary.name: equal_person_fixed_five_class_macro_F1
primary.aggregation: Combine each person’s confusion counts across all of their nights, compute F1 for fixed W,N1,N2,N3,R, then average people equally. Absent and unpredicted class F1=0; probability ties choose first fixed class.
primary.rationale: Matches the known categorical stage labels while limiting dominance of common stages and long recordings; report absolute quality before any signal or mode gain.

secondary: Per-person confusion matrices, support, class F1/recall and truth-supported balanced accuracy.
Candidate-minus-fixed RF and candidate-minus-YASA differences on the exact finite panel.
For separately qualified full153 comparisons: C,EC,OC,EOC absolute panels and original-versus-shifted same-state sensitivity; no modality gain substitutes for absolute EOC score.
Probability calibration/log-loss diagnostics require actual probability panels; cannot reconstruct them from confusion counts.

comparators.name: clock / training-majority
comparators.inputs: Declared clock variables or training-person class proportions only.
comparators.procedure: Prespecified nuisance controls with no development hypnogram fitting.

comparators.name: fixed RF feature baseline
comparators.inputs: Same training people and engineered EEG/EOG/clock view.
comparators.procedure: Existing finite saved RF comparator; future complete-source fitting must keep all selection training-only.

comparators.name: fixed YASA components/ensemble
comparators.inputs: Supplied pretrained full-recording component probabilities in finite model-assisted condition.
comparators.procedure: Existing measured comparator, never a perfect-answer oracle; weights/context differ from feature model and from EOG-only changes.

nuisance_controls: All nights grouped by person, no label-dependent sleep-window cropping.
Separate feature, raw and pretrained-output observations and account for checkpoint exposure and preparation cost.
Clock-only/majority references, fixed context budgets and same-state shifted-input diagnostics; a shift is an alignment sensitivity check, not a causal null.
Full-source fitting-profile differences in query-visible method selection and amortized fitting must be reported, not assumed equal actual compute.
evaluation.uncertainty: Finite two-person results are descriptive, with both person values retained and no population interval. Full153 report provides person vectors and six-fold sensitivity, but shared training and one campaign do not justify naive independent-epoch or independent-fold confidence intervals.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require exact full-clock IDs and finite5-class probabilities summing to1 within1e-6 before any private labels; reject missing/extra/compressed/object arrays or invalid identities. Preserve operator failures separately; do not drop poor stages/people or crop after seeing labels.

resources.basis: Planning estimate only; reuse author processed inputs first. Training/runtime/storage not measured for this task.

source_storage_evidence.observed_total_archive_size: 8.1 GB uncompressed according to publisher; includes Sleep Telemetry outside the proposed first scope.
source_storage_evidence.bounded_intake_plan: Two participant nights for schema/loader checks, then a person-grouped development panel; do not select nights or people based on reference performance.
source_storage_evidence.compute_estimate: CPU-oriented bandpower plus random forest; runtime/RAM not measured, and entire archive need not be loaded simultaneously.
